source_records.title: Results from a wake-steering experiment at a commercial wind plant: investigating the wind speed dependence of wake-steering performance
source_records.version: Final article, 12 November 2021, Wind Energy Science 6, 1427-1453
limitations: Hourly toggling identifies controller-mode application boundaries; it does not establish randomization or independence between applications.
The paper reports resampling one-minute observations. That analysis description is retained; the present question concerns assignment, not a verdict on all confidence intervals.
No timestamped campaign log is included in this package; no total number of eligible hourly applications is inferred.

source_records.title: Copper nanoparticles on controlled pore glass (CPG) as highly efficient heterogeneous catalysts for 'click reactions'
inspected_locations: Procedure for recycling, PDF pp. 3 and 6
limitations: Figure 2 endpoint conversion does not establish unchanged kinetics: Figure 3 and the text report slowing after two cycles.
The recycling procedure uses two hours; the three-hour general procedure is a different scope.

These eight cycles document one catalyst reuse history. They do not establish independent synthesis-series replication, complete material conservation, or identical catalyst composition across cycles.

source_records.title: Effective Ti-6Al-4V Powder Recycling in LPBF Additive Manufacturing Considering Powder History
source_records.version: Repository copy with final Sustainability 2023, 15, 15582 headers; published 2 November 2023
inspected_locations: Build-8 top-up paragraph and final paragraph, PDF p. 6
limitations: The repository PDF visibly overprints earlier text on portions of pp. 5-6, including older peer-review headers. The build-8 statement and final sampling paragraph remain readable; the overprint is saved, not silently repaired.
The bulk index assumes degradation related to material built and no interactions. It is not a particle-level lineage ledger.

Exact input-lot IDs, fractions, and per-particle exposure histories are not established by the supplied methods. This is an evidence-coverage statement, not a claim that the investigators never kept such records.
Publisher HTML returned HTTP 403 during acquisition; the repository copy was inspected.

source_records.title: Bayesian Optimised Collection Strategies for Fatigue Strength Testing
limitations: The regular staircase in Figure 11(a) is the selected protocol. The step tests in Figure 11(c,d) repeatedly load the same specimen and must not be merged into this scope.
Random specimen extraction and randomized protocol order do not imply randomized stress selection.
No digitized stress-by-specimen dataset is asserted; no exact count at a chosen stress is estimated from plot pixels.

Figure 11(a)'s visible stress spacing appears smaller than the 30 MPa increment stated in Table 3 and the figure caption. The achieved numerical step is unresolved here; the next-specimen and outcome-dependent allocation descriptions remain explicit.

source_records.title: Statistical properties of paired fixed fields
source_records.version: arXiv:1806.01871v1, submitted 5 June 2018; PDF draft dated 7 June 2018
inspected_locations: Section 2: fixed and paired fields, PDF pp. 2-3
Section 3.2, Equation 10 and discussion of cross-correlation, PDF p. 5
limitations: Phase reversal is a deterministic initial-field relationship; it does not mean every final observable is perfectly anticorrelated.
The N1000 paired-fixed subset is separate from the 100 standard realizations and the N20/H200/H20 sets.
The published article DOI 10.3847/1538-4357/aae52b is a related version, not a second source or an audited replacement for v1.

source_records.title: CESM2 Large Ensemble Community Project (LENS2)
source_records.version: Undated official project documentation, live snapshot at access
inspected_locations: Modifications incorporated in the second half of the LENS2 simulations, all paragraphs
limitations: The SMBB half also contains emission and carbon-flux code corrections; a between-half contrast does not isolate smoothing alone.
The project reports no significant model-solution or climate-changing impacts from the respective corrections. That report does not establish identical implementations.
The local snapshot is authoritative for this problem; a future website update could change the documentation.
related_sources: The project cites Rodgers et al. (2021); the paper is not counted as another independently inspected source here.

source_records.title: Powerful Foldover Designs
source_records.version: arXiv:2507.14648v1, submitted 19 July 2025; PDF cover dated 22 July 2025
inspected_locations: Table 1, factor names and low/high levels, PDF p. 3; temperature wording compared with Section 6, PDF p. 22
limitations: The caption describes foldover pairs, while the preceding paragraph explicitly mentions both replicates and foldover pairs. The full matrix resolves which are equal conditions; no incompatible assignment remains.

Table 1 (PDF p. 3) provides the eight factor names and low/high levels. It lists temperature levels of 750 and 800 °C, whereas Section 6 describes each cycle as operating at 800 °C. This discrepancy remains unresolved for reconstructing physical operating conditions. The present judgment concerns equality of the eight-factor coded settings in Table 7, not chemical equivalence outside that design.
Later publication is not substituted for the inspected preprint.

source_records.title: Extensive Comparison between INRIM and a Secondary Calibration Laboratory using a Multifunction Electrical Calibrator
source_records.version: arXiv:1510.07866v3, 21 April 2016; downloaded PDF has 7 pages
inspected_locations: Sections IV-V, Figure 3 and Equations 1-5, PDF p. 3
limitations: The preprint retains a template identification header; this is not a second experiment.
The source takes precautions against possible drift and reports instrument stability; a bracketing design does not establish observed drift.

Shared traceability creates particular correlated uncertainty contributions. Separate laboratory executions remain real; the question does not declare all uncertainty components identical or all errors perfectly correlated.

source_records.title: Evaluation of the Wyoming Weather Modification Pilot Project (WWMPP) Using Two Approaches: Traditional Statistics and Ensemble Modeling
source_records.version: Rasmussen et al., Journal of Applied Meteorology and Climatology 57 (2018), 2639-2660; author-uploaded full text, 26 December 2018
inspected_locations: Figure 1 caption and complementary-shading explanation, pp. 2641-2642

Publisher Table 1, printed p. 2642: all monthly generator-exclusion cells and margins, with the caption checked against the author-uploaded full text. https://journals.ametsoc.org/view/journals/apme/57/11/full-jamc-d-17-0335.1-t1.jpg
limitations: Full article text was inspected through the author-uploaded ResearchGate page; full PDF retrieval and publisher article access returned HTTP 403. Publisher Table 1 was retrieved separately and visually checked on 2026-09-21.

Table 1 generator exclusions sum to eight across monthly cells, but the margins and prose report nine. The March cells sum to zero versus a row total of one; the 2008/09 cells sum to two versus a column total of three. The 118 retained EUs are the author-reported total, not a reconciled reconstruction from every cell. No missing event is imputed.

The Table 1 caption assigns four EUs failing both precipitation and generator checks to precipitation QC. The nine generator exclusions are additional to the 27 precipitation exclusions; overlapping failures are not subtracted again.
The prose calls the winters 2008-13, while Table 1 uses 2008/09-2013/14. The present scope is the explicitly reported 118 retained EUs, not reconstructed dates.
Wind-direction criteria differ between the introductory account and Section 2b; this does not change the documented complementary assignment.
Cross-range exposure evidence used in E010 comes from CLOUD-2014 slides 24 and 29, not an independently replicated experiment.
The paper's p-value gloss is not adopted as a probability that the null hypothesis is true; significance testing is outside this problem.
related_sources: CLOUD-2014 is the same experiment, not independent source replication.

source_records.title: Wyoming Weather Modification Pilot Project: Final Results Presentation
source_records.version: Investigators' December 2014 results presentation; 50-slide public copy hosted in a 2024 directory
inspected_locations: Slides 16-18: paired design, measurements, and 118-case assignment plot
limitations: The slide plot labels Medicine Bow, whereas the 2018 Figure 1 plot labels Sierra Madre. Their colors must not be joined as though they identify the same target.
The PDF has malformed object offsets tolerated by the PDF readers; rendered slides were checked.
The slide p-value wording is not used as a statistical reference.
related_sources: CLOUD-2018 reports the same WWMPP trial.

grouping_note: Source families group related documents and prior use, not statistically independent observations. N-STRIP shares the existing C01 source N; N-FOLD is the same handbook. CLOUD-2014 and CLOUD-2018 are one trial.
